notes: The first turned movement, and the first where the ball is not in front of the athlete. The manual has the worker facing to a side while the passer places the ball in front of them, so the trunk is turned and the near hand does the work. Hand offsets are measured in the turned frame, so they follow the trunk.

keys.name: facing_away
keys.note: Facing to the side, hands ready. The passer is off the athlete's right shoulder.

keys.name: reach
keys.note: Turning in toward the ball. The near hand goes first, alone.

keys.name: contact
keys.note: The near hand controls the ball out in front, still turned.

keys.name: gather
keys.note: Squaring up as the second hand arrives on the ball.

keys.name: pull_in
keys.note: Square to the passer, ball in to the chest, ready to pass back.
